about: §35 (review 0-1 follow-up): the relying party a build's passkeys live under, one rule (service_defaults::relying_party_id for native builds, web_relying_party_id for the web wallet), replayed by every shell. getvela.app's association files list only the store apps, so a release build alone uses getvela.app; a test build on a simulator or emulator, and the web dev server, use localhost; a test build on a device uses its TEST_RP_DOMAIN and refuses, with TEST_RP_DOMAIN_UNSET, when it has none — never a quiet fall-back to getvela.app. A release build never reads the test domain.
